'''Khemerion''' was a [[Planet/Legends|planet]] in the [[Expansion Region/Legends|Expansion Region]], on which the [[Confederacy of Independent Systems/Legends|Separatist]] [[Ruusaan Skirata]] was detained by the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic]] during the [[Clone Wars/Legends|Clone Wars]].
